notes.title: Full Release Update
notes.content:
Over the past 6 months and 15 updates, we have thoroughly reworked all game mechanics, enhanced crafting, reduced jankiness, and significantly optimized performance.

As the game leaves Early Access, development will continue. We are concentrating our efforts on developing the Survival mode on a massive map, one of the largest in VR gaming. Our aim is for REQUISITION VR to be the best survival game in VR, and we need your support to achieve this goal.

[previewyoutube=l2jTdUssrEk;full][/previewyoutube]

Many players requested firearm linking and improved gun sounds, so we've completely reworked the gunplay.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41329320/38cad74ea041b6fb3c4ec983a73f722ea2f971a6.png[/img]

Additionally, players asked for the ability to link items to rotating surfaces, which is now possible.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41329320/d6200a09ffa89362e48b3a23168dd83bc9e9db6a.png[/img]

Zombies and melee have also been redone almost from scratch. Zombie piercing mechanic returned
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41329320/d5376465291a3a2908d18c940b4eb4936bf72b4a.png[/img]

New types of zombies
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41329320/b5fbbe2ce5c9dcaec2079becca82ce323a37a5a2.png[/img]

More detailed information about the new update can be found below:

[b]#Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Numerous fixes to trap behavior and some items in traps.
[*] Fixed an issue with "sliding" weapons in hands on certain gamepads.
[*] Fixed issues with displaying sockets in furniture - now they are correctly hidden and displayed. Adjusted distance and manifestation speed.
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed players to grab items from their own backpack while it was on their back.
[*] Improved item synchronization.
[/list]
[b]#Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Weapon linking - now you can attach sharp objects (knives, katanas) to weapons, and add improvements like flashlights and laser sights.
[*] Zombies now dismember during explosions (arms and legs fly off).
[*] Added armored zombies. Until the armor is broken, it blocks damage to the body part it covers.
[*] Added zombies with buboes. When the bubo explodes, a toxic cloud appears, damaging the player.
[*] Improved backpack and pocket interaction interface.
[*] Sockettrig improvements - throwing behind the back, retrieving shotgun cartridges one at a time.
[*] Added a notepad containing background information on the game.
[*] Redesigned tutorial for better clarity and detail.
[*] Ability to remove items over the right shoulder into the backpack if the right operational socket of the backpack is already occupied by an item.
[*] Added the ability to manually remove magazines from weapons.
[*] Added a shooting range to the lobby.
[*] System for storing items in a backpack.
[*] Personal container system in the lobby.
[*] Added crafting workbenches to the lobby.
[*] Introduced functionality for unlocking skins through special boxes.
[/list]
[b]#Tweaks[/b]
[list]
[*] Simplified linking process - no need to hold one of the keys while winding.
[*] Redesigned teslagun projectile - now it actually flies and interacts with the first target it collides with during flight.
[*] Significantly reworked weapon sounds.
[*] Added sounds to items that were missing them.
[/list]

notes.title: Roadmap: November + December
notes.content:
Hey Nevermonsters! 

Time passed so quickly… Tomorrow is already December and more than a month has passed since the EA release of Requisition VR. 

We have a lot to say and wanted to sort of [b]summarize this month in figures[/b]. 

8 patches were released which significantly improved the state of the game in terms of fixing bugs and lags. The patch #6 also became the first huge update since release. It had new features such as in-game store in horde mode for purchasing weapons, traps, and bombs using kill points. 

The latest two patches became two major November updates including new zombie models, new weapon, a vending machine for buying items, Sandbox mode, new map in Horde mode and a lot more! 

The full list of all updates and fixes can be found here: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1730650 

[b]And a little about our plans for December.[/b] We did some changes in our Road Map, so here’s what we’re planning for the end of the year: Christmas packs (new items, clothes), new Christmas zombie models, new Story mode map, and some other fun stuff! Are you excited?

We are really grateful for your support and feedback! A lot of stuff this month was made just because of you.

Thanks for hanging out with us! 

Your fellow zombie friends,
Arcadia VR

notes.title: The true story of zombie apocalypse
notes.content:
[b]Greetings and welcome to the Requisition VR![/b]

Requisition VR is an action survival shooter where you become a Nevermont survivor of a zombie outbreak. Now you have to fight to stay alive in an apocalyptic world.

The game is based on the team's vision of how it would look like a zombie apocalypse in a calm and peaceful city, and also it is inspired by pop culture and the most popular theories about apocalypse.

The team started developing the game over a year ago. We thought about the lore first. It was really necessary to show our vision by the atmosphere of zombie apocalypses and especially the steps of citizens to survive.

So we decided to divide lore into two parts. The first part is shown in the cutscenes of the game. The second part is the atmosphere of the gameplay. Today we will try to show you this atmosphere. Read, if you’re interested.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41329320/77c22972837f626357761324ec5184f4241c7815.jpg[/img]

[b]Just imagine. 
At some point everything feels wrong, the dead bodies are walking on the streets and attacking your neighbors. And what should you do in that case? Right, you try to survive in any way and save what is still having a great sentimental value for you.

You already can't leave the house, you're armless. You take whatever lies around and try to fight with it. It works, it definitely works. So you decide to take as much stuff as possible from the kitchen or wardrobe to prepare for the next attack. Right after you deal with it, you know that your home is not safe anymore and you have to run. Run until you feel safe again.

After a few days, you explored the area, you were at a gas station, you even found some people and united with them. Now you're not alone. There are people stronger and weaker than you but anyway it feels safer than being all alone. 

You don't remember how many dead walking bodies you saw. They were already dead but you had to kill them again. And you killed.

Of course, you read about it in comics and books, and you saw movies, but no one told you that it'll happen to you someday. 

Again, there are no guns or knives nearby. Someone already tried to get out of there, he took everything to survive and run. You can't judge them. You would do the same. And again, if you're under attack, you already know that - take anything that could save your life. 

Day 1 … 7 ... maybe 30 of your traveling and surviving. You don't know what day of the week is today. 
How many people you lost, how many "people" you killed. You don't care about savings, now you have another currency - life. 

You're looking for people, you're looking for a safe and quiet place, food, and a bed. It's not even scary anymore. And it's even not surprising after all you passed.

You know that it's just the beginning of your journey.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41329320/85b21dbb34928fad060081af444f4270aa9eade8.jpg[/img]

There is a lore we show you via cutscenes, locations, mechanics, multiplayer and more things in gameplay. 

It's also the beginning for Requisition VR game. It's in Early Access and we're adding new journeys, and new mechanics, and improving the game for you daily.

If you're willing to dive deeper into the story, we invite you to play Requisition VR.

notes.title: Locations - Lonely house with the bunker
notes.content:
No one believed Walter and that was what killed them. 

Even his son Jacob was a stubborn man who refused to share his constant fear of the world ending. 

They would all regret it. 

That’s what he thought, building an underground bunker under his cozy hut in the middle of the forest. He stuffed it with canned food and protein bars knowing that when the day would come they would all thank Walter and ask for the help. 

Oh how they would regret… 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41329320/0eb873fc04eb236d36feb843041c3a37f29d8dcf.png[/img]

Walter looked into the bathroom mirror. The cold running water cooled down his burning face and rapid thoughts from all the hard work he’s done. He was 62 and it took him almost seven years to finish the bunker he was really proud about. He definitely knew that the day he was dreaded about the most would come. It was this sinking feeling in his gut causing him to wake up in cold sweat every night. He knew that their local government was too shady about the closed part of the city and nuclear power plant. Something was going on. Something bad. 

Jacob called him that morning to know if he was alright. 

He was. Except something buzzing inside his head causing him to have almost no sleep last night. His senses, almost like dogs’, were going crazy, making him thrilled and nervous about everything that happened around him. Walter could jump up when the phone rang or the mailman came with his morning paper. He would go downstairs to the bunker to calm himself by looking at the walls that could protect them, to the warm light giving this area slight comfort. 

He was going to be just fine. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41329320/bba18cd27d425013cb52832f1986d82aa3b6d798.png[/img]

Jacob called him that day to say that Walter needed to stay inside. 

But he already knew after all these noises and explosions what was going to happen. 

He locked himself in the bunker. He started to pray. He could see himself living here for a very long time. He could see himself surviving. 

Too bad no one listened to him when there was time. 

Walter sat on the floor and closed his eyes.

notes.title: Locations - Farm
notes.content:
Jen and Ben… what an odd combination… were indeed the odd combination. 

A police officer and a junkie weren’t the most strange companions during the end of the world. But they certainly could draw some attention and became characters for the guide “How to survive an apocalypse 101”. 

[b]Tip №1. Find a companion who makes you laugh or at least tries… 
[/b]
- Sooooo… Last night while you were sleeping I was brave enough to be on duty… - Jen shoots him a deadly glare which was her usual glare when Ben said or did something, - oh don’t give me the evil eye… you remember those delicious ice cream… Ben and Jerry and we are Ben and Jen… got it? 

- Dude, now I want ice cream and blow your brains out… get up, we should leave and find a better safe place. Let’s check the farm we saw the other night. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41329320/f333dec32052434bb4a700a514bf9c639ffba841.png[/img]

[b]Tip №2. Don’t dwell on past, think positively and keep searching
[/b]
- This place looks like a total nightmare. 

For the first time Jen totally agreed with Ben. An old abandoned farm sended shivers down her spine with its old creaky houses and dead silence. She thought of this place when it was full of life and hard work of people who lived here. There must be tons of cute animals and farmers who cared about them. And now what? They were all eaten by hordes of unknown monsters or became monsters themselves…? She thought of a zombie cow and shuddered. 

When she saw this farm afar she was full of hope that this place would have some people in it. She imagined it being defended, crowded with survivors and stacked with food and water. She hated the feeling of being alone, she always had someone to get her back. Working in the police she had her partner but Ray didn’t make it after the last horde invaded their camp and now she was stuck with Ben. 

- Just let’s find something we can use and maybe stay the night here. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41329320/74c0dc3d92e4ce951326d135fc8d61f1b24ca2d5.png[/img]

[b]Tip №3. Be open to the new experiments 
[/b]
- No bullets, no guns… what the hell is it… 

Jen stopped her searching and looked at Ben with an unreadable expression when the sound of duct tape caught her attention. There was something in his hand she couldn’t put a name on but Ben looked so proud standing inside a creepy farm house that used to be a barn with what looked like cow feeders and rolls of hay around. 

- That’s a killer weapon! No zombie will stay alive! 

- That’s a rake and three knives attached to it with the duct tape. Who are you gonna kill with it? 

- What’s your ultimate weapon, smart ass? 
 
- Easy, the gun, - Jen showed her old trusty gun that saved her life many times even before everything started. 

- Yeah? And what if one day you will wake up and realize that no bullet left in this world? - Ben smiled like he was saying something funny, but that didn’t make Jen laugh. She felt this punch of fear when she realized that he was right. The world was slowly dying, the resources were decreasing and soon or later if she was alive she had to learn how to defend herself without bullets. 

- Okay… show me what and how you did it. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41329320/7dcee6700392786b43833522fa0b142714189bb7.png[/img]

[b]Tip №4. Try to be quiet 
[/b]
It was supposed to be the ordinary farm. But a huge territory looks like it just became a ghost town with no one around. It felt like people just disappeared or went to sleep. The tractors stayed untouched, the hay was just there waiting to be eaten by animals. The only strange thing here was Ben. Damn Ben. 

- That’s ridiculous. You can go around with this stuff. 

- Why? - he was clearly showing off with that thing he made earlier. Jen was slowly adjusting to the fact that his crazy mind had suddenly get more crazier and instead of being the Professor Stupid Jokes he suddenly became a Professor Bizzare Craft. Now he was holding the hammer with the broken attached to it, - oh man, I would love to ride on this thing, - his gaze focused on a tractor. 

- No, you wouldn’t.

- Why? 

- Because the whole friendly neighborhood of zombies will come here to join your ride. We are not in the video game, grab your whatever it is and let’s search the last house. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41329320/4c7114ad6fce5f784fe3290855a3e7a926ae8e2f.png[/img]

[b]Tip №5. Be ready for everything 
[/b]
- What in the world had happened here? 

The last place to scavenge was beyond their expectations. Instead of feeders and hay the two saw something that was much scarier than monsters trying to kill them. 

Body parts laying around. Blood. Body in a plastic. And the cherry on the top is a giant cross with a zombie attached to it. 

- Nothing good, but we better be quick, Ben. I’m not sure I want to meet someone who did it. That’s just… awful. I am sorry I said your weapons were the worst… I think there are more awful things in this world than it. 

- Glad you appreciated it. Okay, let’s hurry and find something else besides this… ew! Human hearts. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41329320/fb675e0d287f63853a21758789119e5fe6af4dfa.png[/img]

[b]Tip №6. Be cool and have fun
[/b]
Turned out the farm wasn’t the creepiest place they met on their journey.

Ben being a dork had some secrets on his sleeves and he saved their lives not just once. 
Jen used to his jokes and learnt how to craft, no longer relying on the power of the gun with no bullets in it. 

These two were just fine.

notes.title: The glue trap mini-devlog
notes.content:
New day - new mini-devlog! 

This time we are talking about glue traps! 

Let’s see what a trap is according to the Nevermont dictionary. 

If you saw our last video devlog you would probably know everything about traps in Requisition. The trap has a delivery device and trigger. Pretty simple, huh? 

So today we are going to talk about glue traps.

[previewyoutube=2jg8YDblq4Y;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
Glue is a substance that helps to attach any weapon to walls, floor, ceiling, etc. Don’t forget to use the trigger that will activate the trap. You can make it very easy by using something rubbery (like a rubber boot) and an electrical board (just crash a TV with a hammer), go to the workbench and you get yourself a sticky base for the future traps. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41329320/4c7537a284fa22332783c23cfbe3d9a8f12a156d.png[/img]

Here’s what you can do with this big gum… sorry, glue!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41329320/d892de60fb5ade7c4986651fbe3d00e321d99452.png[/img]
Take a shotgun, flamethrower, or machine gun, and glue it down to the surface, then grab a button or tripwire from the workbench and use it as a trigger. Make sure to stick the weapon in the right direction! 

Let’s make zombies regret going into your house!

notes.title: Locations - Gas Station
notes.content:
[h2]Town of Autumn, August 2020 
[/h2]
Kevin came to Autumn after college. His mother believed that her bright son would be a good assistant to the professor at the local university. She also knew that this experience would give him a position as a professor later. 

Kevin was okay with that. Autumn didn’t scare him. It was a small beautiful town on the East Coast and wasn’t different from his hometown. That made him feel better. 

So, Autumn seemed like a good idea. 

He was greeted by the sign “Welcome to Autumn, Nevermont state”. He didn’t get to see the population of the town. The indicator on the dashboard squeaked plaintively drawing his attention. The car was low on gas and he looked nervously at the GPS on his phone to see that a nearby gas station was three miles away. Kevin sighed feeling relieved. 

The gas station looked practically the same as the one in his hometown. A couple of gas pumps, a small shop with hot dogs, junk food, and probably bad coffee, and an auto repair shop.  

He came inside the building with the sign “Market” on it and saw a cashier who was maybe one or two younger than him. 

“Mike,” said a badge on his gray uniform. 

- Hi, how can I help you? 

- Hello, fill’er up, and check the tires, will you?

- Sure, no problem, that would be 52$. 

Kevin nodded and got a credit card. While Mike was busy checking and calling someone named Bill who was supposed to look at the tires, he looked around. As he thought before, that was the typical gas station, the same one he saw hundreds of times driving with his dad to school and home. 

He noticed his favorite chips and smiled. 

Autumn did seem like a good idea. 

[h2]Town of Autumn, March 2022 
[/h2]
Autumn was a bad idea. 

For the first time, mom wasn’t right. 

Kevin didn’t become the professor, he didn’t even stay as the assistant. Apparently, his boss was a total douche that didn’t believe in him, unlike his mother. 

Kevin lost his job, his money, and his dignity. Eventually, he replaced Mike at the gas station who married and moved to a bigger city to raise a family. 

He started to hate the smell of gas. 
He started to hate Bill who was talking about cars all the time. 
He started to hate mom’s calls. She sounded too pitiful. 
He started to hate the taste of his favorite chips. 
He started to hate everybody who stopped to fill their cars with gas. 

Kevin thought they had life and he didn’t. 

[h2]Town of Autumn, September 2022 
[/h2]
Autumn was the worst idea ever. 

That stuff on his arm hurt like hell. 

Kevin never saw someone, a person, being so aggressive, when he just asked how he could help. He briefly remembered that he saw this man in the town, but couldn’t recall his name. 

He barricaded himself at the gas station. That wasn’t how he pictured his shift. Kevin looked at the wound, splashed disinfectant he found in the first aid kit, and winced from the pain. All he was hearing were loud thumps from the storage where he locked that crazy growling man. That was scarier than being interviewed at the university two years ago. 

Kevin thought about Bill. What happened to him? Was he safe? He clenched his teeth, got up, and saw a wrench that Bill left near the counter this morning. The growl got louder, and the door shook under the pressure. Kevin grabbed the wrench and came closer to the door. 

He won’t be the employee of the month, but at least he will try.

notes.title: Locations mini-devlog
notes.content:
Hey Nevermonsters!

Imagine the typical American town with small houses, old monuments in beautiful parks, all covered in trees, and meeting all the requirements of the American dream. 

Autumn was just like that. Located in the heart of Nevermont state with a great history and magnificent landscapes. The Early Access release of the Requisition VR will contain different locations, and we decided to run a series of mini-devlogs about locations. 

First on the menu is a location that all of you already know if you watched our trailers. 

[b]The Hut. [/b]

The Hut is a huge cabin hidden in the forest filled with the death and horrors of the apocalypse. This is your first stop because you need to bring something useful back to your community as you become a scavenger in the Story Mode of the EA version. 

The Hut is a two-story wooden building that could look very cozy and delightful if it wasn’t for a horde of mutants desiring to shred you to pieces. So yeah, the Hut is basically filled with stuff, but you wouldn’t be able to take it home because you would need all of it to protect yourself. 

[previewyoutube=KAIin6Y9o-0;full][/previewyoutube]

Make sure to barricade windows, so please don’t be shy and destroy all the beautiful furniture inside the house. 

Run to the kitchen and grab the floor, beer, and soda cans, no, that’s not a cooking lesson for making a lovely dinner, that’s your survival kit to craft weapons, traps, and bombs. 

And that’s a living room. Oh, how would it be nice to sit by the fire in the comfortable chair and drink some tea listening to the sound of the wind… oh no, that’s not the wind, that’s zombies crawling into your space. 

Hurry up and defend the Hut!

notes.title: The First Aid mini devlog
notes.content:
You’re wounded, but you’re not dead. Yet. 

Your HP can severely suffer after meeting one or two hungry zombies. Вut don’t worry, we got you covered!

If you’re bitten, always remember about the magic power of [b]medicines and food[/b]. Grab something! Eat it! You’re not you when you’re hungry! 

Let’s say you’re playing with your friends in multiplayer. You were bitten by zombies because you’re their favorite snack. After three delicious bites, you will be heavily damaged and wouldn’t be able to get up and use voice chat to call for help. But don’t get all frustrated! You’re not gonna die. Probably. Your teammates could easily detect you if you use a special button on the controller. Or, if they’re attentive enough, they could check you out. If they see a zombie party around you, that’s their call - you need to be saved. 

[b]A defibrillator[/b] is a good way to save your teammate. Yeah, sounds crazy. But you don’t have to be a doctor to perform something like that. 

The defibrillator could be found in locations or crafted on a workbench. But its life is definitely shorter than yours. You can use it only twice. 
Please don’t try this at home! 

Don’t forget to wishlist REQUISITION VR! 
Stay tuned to learn more about the game!

notes.title: Game modes POLL
notes.content:
Hey! 
Your decisions can improve the game!

[b]Check out these game modes carefully. What modes would you like to see in the game? 
[/b]

We'll try to implement them ASAP. Multiple choice is OK.

Each game mode includes the following features: 
- Craft on the run
- Craft on the workbench
- Traps and barricades
- Melee
- Gunplay

[olist]
[*] [b]Sandbox
 [/b]Players can craft weapons, construct traps and barricades. But there will be no waves of zombies until the player decides to spawn zombies by pressing a button.

[*] [b]Short session (survival mode)
[/b]At each location, the player has only one goal - to survive 3 waves of zombies

[*] [b]Horde mode
[/b]2-4 players defend the house from waves of zombies using a small number of guns and items to barricade the house and craft weapons and traps. The goal is to survive as many waves as possible.

[*] [b]Story mode
 [/b]A story campaign where players complete missions in different locations. Players will see an animated comic after each mission. Players can loot items to use in the next mission. Missions help players to dig into the story of Requisition.

[*] [b]Hunt
[/b]A "killer" and 3 "victims" are randomly selected from 4 players at the start of the session. The killer has a gun, and the victims have no weapons. Victims will have to craft weapons from items found in the house and create and set traps. The "killer" needs to kill all the players, while the "victims" need to get rid of the "killer."

[*] [b]Home Alone
 [/b]Three players storm the house while one player defends it by setting traps.

[*] [b]Deathmatch[/b]
Every player is all alone against other players and zombies. The goal is to kill others as many times as possible. Players will respawn after death. Each session will last for 10 minutes. Players are able to craft weapons and make traps.

[*] Real-time strategy
Several players defend the house from zombies, and one of the players controls the crowds of zombies using a computer IRL telling zombies where to go and who to attack.

[*] Capture the flag (Squad vs. Squad)
 Teams play 2v2. Each team has its own house. The players need to set traps in their house and break into the other team's house to steal items.

[/olist]
